title: Playwright Automation Test Engineer
description:
Job Description: Playwright Automation Test Engineer Job Title: Playwright Automation Test Engineer
 Experience: 1-6 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
 Location: Chennai / Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Remote (based on business requirements)
 Industry: IT Services & Consulting Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Playwright Automation Test Engineer to design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Playwright, programming languages such as JavaScript or TypeScript, and modern software testing methodologies. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright. Perform functional, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing. Automate web application testing across supported browsers. Develop reusable test frameworks and automation utilities. Identify, document, track, and troubleshoot software defects. Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines. Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product teams. Execute API testing and validate application responses. Analyze test results and prepare automation reports. Maintain test scripts and improve test coverage. Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and defect reviews. Ensure application quality, reliability, and performance. Required Skills Hands-on experience with Playwright automation testing. Strong knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience with web application testing and test automation frameworks. Understanding of locators, assertions, waits, fixtures, and page object models. Knowledge of test case design, defect life cycle, and regression testing. Experience with Git and version control systems. Familiarity with API testing and REST APIs. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Playwright Test Runner. Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Experience with cross-browser testing. Knowledge of Selenium or Cypress. Familiarity with Postman and API automation. Experience with Docker and cloud-based testing environments. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Relevant automation testing experience is preferred. Who Should Apply? QA Automation Engineers with hands-on Playwright experience. Software Test Engineers transitioning from Selenium or Cypress to Playwright. Candidates experienced in JavaScript/TypeScript-based test automation. Interested candidates: Apply with your updated resume highlighting your Playwright experience, programming skills, automation framework expertise, current location, and notice period. Send your resume at Careers@sparktechwiz.com

Key Skills: Playwright,Testng,Test Planning,Test Scenarios,Software testing,Planning,Automation testing,Automation
